title: Police Report Regarding A Foreigner In Custody Of Japanese Military 11-12-37

page_data.en:
Comtesse Jean Jacques
Switzerland                                      P.O. Francis
5.45 p.m.           11th. Dec. 1937

My name is Comtesse Jean Jacques, aged 29, Swiss nationality
employed by Scharff Guenter & Company, office situated at No.666
Szechuen Road. I am attached to the Transportation Department
of the afore-mentioned firm and am in possession of Swiss passport
No.335606/177, issued at Berne on the 1st June 1936.
At 7 a.m. on the 11-12-37, Mr. Guenter instructed me to take
charge of a motor launch "Asia" (blank) which was tied up to the
Customs Jetty, The Bund, and proceed down the Whangpoo River to
Bush Island. Mr. Guenter accompanied me on the launch and there
were about 100 Chinese passengers as well as the crew on board.
The launch arrived at Bush Island outside Moosung at about
8.30 a.m. and took on board Poultry and vegetables as well as
another 90 passengers. My launch was flying the German flag, and
at about 10.30 a.m. as same was passing Kiangchow Creek a Japanese
tug flying the Japanese flag sounded the whistle and signalled
for me to stop my launch. Owing to my launch being travelling
at a fast rate of speed, I could not slow it down as quickly as
was requested by the Japanese, with the result that some Japanese
soldiers on board the tug opened fire with their rifles, and
covered my launch with a machine gun. All the shots fired passed
through cargo on board my launch, and none of the passengers were
in anyway injured.
I stopped my launch alongside the Japanese tug, and asked
why they had opened fire. Then a Japanese dressed in soldier's
pants, leather jacket and army cap drew a pistol, and flourishing
same ordered me in pidgin English to board his tug. I refused to
do so, and he again threatening me with his pistol left his tug
page_data.zh:
让·雅克伯爵夫人 (Comtesse Jean Jacques)
瑞士                                      P.O. Francis
下午 5:45           1937年12月11日

本人名为让·雅克伯爵夫人，29岁，瑞士籍，
受雇于沙尔夫·根特公司 (Scharff Guenter & Company)，办公地点位于四川路666号。本人隶属于上述公司的运输部，持有1936年6月1日在伯尔尼签发的瑞士护照，号码为335606/177。
1937年12月11日上午7时，根特先生指示我负责管理一艘停泊在外滩海关码头的机动驳船“亚洲”号 (Asia)（空白），并沿黄浦江下行前往布什岛 (Bush Island)。根特先生随我一同乘船，船上约有100名中国乘客以及船员。
驳船于上午8时30分左右抵达吴淞外的布什岛，装载了家禽和蔬菜，并另外搭载了90名乘客。我的驳船悬挂德国国旗，上午10时30分左右，当驳船经过江洲浜 (Kiangchow Creek) 时，一艘悬挂日本国旗的日本拖轮鸣笛并示意我停船。由于我的驳船行驶速度较快，我无法按照日方要求迅速减速，结果拖轮上的一些日本士兵用步枪开火，并用机枪扫射我的驳船。所有射出的子弹都穿过了我船上的货物，乘客均未受到任何伤害。
我将驳船停靠在日本拖轮旁，询问他们为何开火。随后，一名身穿军裤、皮夹克并戴着军帽的日本人拔出手枪，挥舞着枪支，用洋泾浜英语命令我登上他的拖轮。我拒绝这样做，他再次用手枪威胁我，然后离开他的拖轮

page_data.en:
and boarded by launch. This Japanese struck me about the chest
with his fist, pulled my necktie, and shirt, then called some
Japanese soldiers to pull me on board their tug. Some other
Japanese soldiers were ordered to board my launch and stand
guard.

I was taken on board the Japanese tug to a small and pontoon
and then placed in the custody of army soldiers. A typewritten
statement was given me, no questions were asked, and any question I
asked was not answered. On arrival at 12 noon a Chinese whom the
Japanese had seized and who was one of the staff of the
Shanghai Tug and Lighter Co., was produced. I asked for the
services of an interpreter but this was also refused. I was then
left standing inside an office of the Government Ferry Building
whilst the party of Japanese soldiers went to their lunch.

At about 1.30 p.m. I noticed a foreigner standing on the
bund and asked him to notify the S.M.P. police that I was being
detained by the Japanese military. Some 10 minutes later a police
car stopped in front of the pontoon, the foreign officers got out
and looked around. I shouted to them and on observing me they
walked towards the pontoon. They were seen by the Japanese who
rushed at me, and pushed me towards the edge of the pontoon near
the river. I caught hold of an iron grille which closes the
entrance to the pontoon from the bund, but a soldier punched me
on the back and head. He then called other soldiers to his
assistance, and pulling out his sword pointed same at my right
side. I let go my hold of the grille, and they pushed me onto
the tug which had brought me from Kiaochoo. I was then forced
into a cabin.
page_data.zh:
登上了我的驳船。这名日本人用拳头击打我的胸部，拉扯我的领带和衬衫，然后叫来一些日本士兵将我拖上他们的拖轮。其他一些日本士兵奉命登上我的驳船并担任警戒。

我被带到日本拖轮上的一个小浮码头，随后被置于陆军士兵的监管之下。他们给我一份打字声明，未提出任何问题，我也未得到对我所提问题的任何回答。中午12时到达时，一名被日本人抓获的中国人被带了出来，此人是上海拖驳公司 (Shanghai Tug and Lighter Co.) 的职员之一。我要求提供翻译服务，但也遭到拒绝。随后，我被留在政府轮渡站大楼的一间办公室内站立，而那群日本士兵去吃午饭了。

下午1时30分左右，我注意到一名外国人站在外滩，便请他通知工部局警务处 (S.M.P.) 警察，我正被日军拘留。大约10分钟后，一辆警车停在浮码头前，外籍警官下车四处张望。我向他们呼喊，他们看到我后便向浮码头走来。日本人看到了他们，冲向我，并将我推向靠近河边的浮码头边缘。我抓住了一道关闭从外滩进入浮码头入口的铁栅栏，但一名士兵击打我的背部和头部。随后他叫来其他士兵协助，拔出佩刀指向我的右侧。我松开了抓着栅栏的手，他们把我推上了那艘把我从胶州 (Kiaochoo) 带来的拖轮。随后我被强行关进一间舱室。

page_data.en:
The tug moved down the river and as it passed Ching-king-
anit which is in front and on the Pootung side of The Shanghai
Tower Co., the tug drew in alongside a jetty, and some of the
Japanese soldiers boarded another launch, which was tied up to
a jetty situated at this particular place, and arrested a German.
He was forced to get into a chair in which he was being detained.
The vessel then proceeded, after the soldiers had
taken possession of my launch and arrived at Miaochow,
about 4 p.m., by way of alongside a lighter which was about 100
yards from the shore, and alongside my own launch. I was then
questioned by them, who questioned me in the Chinese
language, but as I could not understand him, one of my Chinese
crew was brought from my own launch, who as he could speak
English, he acted as interpreter.
I was asked through the interpreter to produce the regis-
tration papers of the launch. I then informed the
Japanese that the launch was the property of Carlowitz & Company,
No.568 Szechuen Road, and that verbal permission had been given
us by the Japanese Consulate, and Naval Commanders to carry on
business up and down the river, also that we were not to be
interfered with. The Japanese then told me that I was not allow-
ed to carry passengers on my launch, only cargo.
I was also asked why I did not stop my launch more quicker
and answered that owing to the speed at which it was travelling,
I could not bring the launch to a stop any quicker.
At about 4.15 p.m. I was allowed to go and told to board my
launch and take same back to Shanghai, where I arrived at about
page_data.zh:
拖轮沿江下行，当经过位于上海塔楼公司 (The Shanghai Tower Co.) 前方浦东一侧的庆宁寺 (Ching-king-anit) 时，拖轮靠向一个码头，一些日本士兵登上另一艘系泊在该特定地点码头的驳船，逮捕了一名德国人。他被强迫坐在一把椅子上，处于被拘留状态。在士兵接管了我的驳船后，该船只继续航行，并于下午4时左右经由一艘距离岸边约100码的驳船旁，以及我自己的驳船旁，抵达庙港 (Miaochow)。随后他们对我进行了审问，审问者使用中文提问，但由于我听不懂，他们从我自己的驳船上带来了一名能讲英语的中国船员担任翻译。
通过翻译，我被要求出示驳船的注册文件。随后我告知日本人，该驳船是卡洛维茨公司 (Carlowitz & Company) 的财产，地址为四川路568号，且日本领事馆和海军指挥官已口头许可我们在江上往返开展业务，并不得受到干扰。日本人随后告诉我，我不允许在驳船上搭载乘客，只能装载货物。
他们还问我为什么没有更快地停下驳船，我回答说，由于驳船行驶的速度，我无法更快地将驳船停下。
下午4时15分左右，我被允许离开，并被告知登上我的驳船将其返回上海，我于大约

page_data.en:
-heet 4-

6.30 p.m., I then reported the occurrence to my office, and went
to Central Police Station.
The other person who was arrested was still being detained
when I was released.
(Sgd.) WITNESSE
page_data.zh:
-第4页-

下午6时30分抵达，随后我向办事处报告了此事，并前往中央巡捕房。
当我获释时，另一名被捕者仍被拘留。
(签名) 证人

page_data.en:
Erich Oehler
Switzerland                                 D.D. Francis
c p.o.                                      11th Dec. 1937

My name is Erich Oehler, aged 31, Swiss nationality. I
am a partner of Oehler & Co., office situated at
No. 60 Nanking Road.

At about 10 a.m. on the 11th inst., I boarded the motor launch
"Hain Klangman" which had just come from Woosung. The Launch,
under the charge of Captain John O'Leary, was attached to the
Transportation Department of my Office.

There were about 100 passengers as well as cargo.
The launch started from the Bund at about 9.30 a.m.,
where other passengers and cargo were taken on board. The launch
which was flying the German flag, was just passing Naochow Creek
at 10.30 a.m. when a Japanese tug signalled us to stop. As
the launch on which I was travelling did not stop quick enough,
some Japanese soldiers on the Japanese tug fired some shots at
us with their rifles. All the shots passed through cargo, none
of the passengers on board being injured.

The launch then drew alongside the Japanese tug, and the
man who seemed to be in charge flourished a pistol, also pointing
same at the passengers on the launch in a threatening manner.
I then went inside a cabin, and about 10 minutes later, I saw
the Japanese tug moving away.

At about 1.30 p.m. the Japanese tug returned and I immediate-
ly returned to a cabin. About 15 minutes later the engine of the
"Hain Klangman" started and the launch moved off. I then went
on deck where I met Mr. Jacques who informed me that he had been
arrested, and detained by the Japanese Military.

When I arrived at the Customs Jetty, I went to my office,
page_data.zh:
埃里希·奥勒 (Erich Oehler)
瑞士                                 D.D. Francis
c p.o.                               1937年12月11日

本人名为埃里希·奥勒，31岁，瑞士籍。
我是奥勒公司 (Oehler & Co.) 的合伙人，办公地点位于南京路60号。

本月11日上午10时左右，我登上了刚从吴淞回来的机动驳船“海康曼”号 (Hain Klangman)。该驳船由约翰·奥利里 (John O'Leary) 船长负责，隶属于我办事处的运输部。

船上约有100名乘客以及货物。
驳船于上午9时30分左右从外滩出发，在那里搭载了其他乘客和货物。这艘悬挂德国国旗的驳船在上午10时30分正经过南洲浜 (Naochow Creek) 时，一艘日本拖轮示意我们停船。由于我乘坐的驳船未能足够快地停下，日本拖轮上的一些日本士兵向我们开枪射击。所有子弹都穿过了货物，船上乘客无人受伤。

随后驳船靠向日方拖轮，那名看似负责人的男子挥舞着手枪，并以威胁的方式将枪指向驳船上的乘客。随后我进入一间舱室，大约10分钟后，我看到日本拖轮驶离。

下午1时30分左右，日本拖轮返回，我立即回到舱室。大约15分钟后，“海康曼”号的引擎启动，驳船驶离。随后我来到甲板上，遇到了雅克先生 (Mr. Jacques)，他告诉我他已被日本军方逮捕并拘留。

当我抵达海关码头时，我去了我的办事处，

page_data.en:
-Sheet 2-

and informed the German Consul re Mr. Jacques having told me
about a German subject whom I knew to be named Mr. Stensslof
having been arrested and detained by the Japanese on board a
tug on the Whangpoo. Then I reported the occurrence concerning
our own launch to Central Police Station.
(Signed) Erich Guenter.
page_data.zh:
-第2页-

并就雅克先生告知我的情况向德国领事报告，即我知道一名名为斯滕斯洛夫先生 (Mr. Stensslof) 的德国臣民在黄浦江上的一艘拖轮上被日本人逮捕并拘留。随后，我就我们自家驳船发生的事件向中央巡捕房报告。
(签名) 埃里希·根特 (Erich Guenter).

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
S. R.C.S 14
Central D. Station,
REPORT
Date 11-12-37 19
Subject Foreigner in custody of Japanese military
Made by Insp. Crownrigg. Forwarded by

Sir,
At about 1.25 p.m. 11-12-37, the S.I. on Charge Room duty informed me that two Japanese officers were in the Charge room and requested my attendance. On my arrival I ascertained the Senior of these officers to be Major Yamamoto of the Kitazuwa Detachment and that he wished to erect a barrier at the City Government Ferry pontoon. As the officer was not quite clear as to what he wished I suggested going down to the pontoon so that I could clearly understand what was wanted. Just as I was leaving the Charge Room a Foreigner (name unknown) came into same and reported that another Foreigner was being held captive on the City Government Ferry pontoon by Japanese Military.

On arrival at the above mentioned pontoon I went to the South end of same to enquire from the J.P.C. on duty if he knew anything about a Foreigner being arrested by the Japanese Military and at this time I heard a cry from the North end of the pontoon.

On turning in that direction I saw a Foreigner inside the locked grille door of the pontoon being hit and pushed by a Japanese Military man and then the same Japanese pulled his sword out and pushed it toward the Foreigner who was then dragged from sight.

On the arrival of Major Yamamoto I explained to him, through the medium of J.P.C. 146 what had happened. The Major, J.P.C. and myself then went to the gate of the pontoon and after sometime were admitted.

The J.P.C. and myself were told to wait whilst the Major went to make enquiries, after a short while the Major return
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号
S. R.C.S 14
中央分区巡捕房，
报告
日期 1937年12月11日 19
主题 被日本军方拘留的外国人
制作人 克朗里格督察 (Insp. Crownrigg). 转发人

先生，
1937年12月11日下午1时25分左右，值班接待室的警司通知我，有两名日本军官在接待室，并要求我到场。到达后，我查明这些军官中级别较高者是北川支队 (Kitazuwa Detachment) 的山本少校 (Major Yamamoto)，他希望在上海市政府轮渡浮码头设置障碍物。由于该军官对其意图表述不太清楚，我建议前往浮码头，以便我能清楚了解其需求。正当我离开接待室时，一名外国人（姓名不详）进入室内，报告称另一名外国人正被日本军方拘禁在上海市政府轮渡浮码头上。

到达上述浮码头后，我前往其南端，向当值的日本警察 (J.P.C.) 查询是否知晓有外国人被日本军方逮捕之事，此时我听到来自浮码头北端的喊叫声。

朝那个方向看去，我看到一名外国人在浮码头锁住的铁栅门内被一名日本军人殴打和推搡，随后同一名日本人拔出佩刀推向该外国人，该外国人随即被拖出视线范围。

山本少校到达后，我通过146号日本警察 (J.P.C. 146) 向他解释了发生的情况。随后，少校、日本警察和我一同前往浮码头大门，过了一段时间后被允许进入。

日本警察和我被告知在此等候，少校前去查询，过了一会儿，少校返回

page_data.en:
Lardy Waits S.M.P.
Report On Saturday
"Kiangnan" Incident

Awaiting the report of the
Shanghai Municipal Police on the
alleged shooting at the launch
Hsin Kiangnan by Japanese
soldiers on Saturday, Mr. F.
Lardy, Swiss consul-general in-
vestigating the facts of the case,
stated the situation was un-
changed this morning. The
charge d'affaires for Switzerland
was informed of the incident by
Mr. J. J. Comtesse, young Swiss
in charge of the launch which
was carrying passengers and
cargo in its regular river trading,
past Kiaochiao Creek when it was
stopped.

It is understood that a Japan-
ese tug hailed the passing launch
and armed men aboard shot at
the vessel flying the German flag
when it failed to come to an im-
mediate stop. No one was
wounded by the bullets, but the
Nipponese then allegedly took
Mr. Comtesse aboard their tug
and brought him to the The
Bund, on the City Government
Ferry pontoon. Here Settlement
Police was reportedly not allowed
to get in touch with him, and he
was stated to have been beaten
by the Japanese and threatened
with a drawn sword in the view
of a number of passers-by. Later
he was taken back to the Kiang-
nan outside Kiaochiao Creek and
there released. Mr. Comtesse is
understood to be the man who
was involved in the Gulfarmod
fraud case that came up in the
Swiss Consular Court a few weeks
ago.
page_data.zh:
拉迪 (Lardy) 致工部局警务处
关于周六
“江南”号事件的报告

在等待工部局警务处关于周六日本士兵涉嫌向“新江南”号 (Hsin Kiangnan) 驳船开枪事件的报告之际，正在调查该案事实的瑞士总领事 F. 拉迪先生表示，今早局势未有变化。瑞士代办已通过负责该驳船的瑞士青年 J. J. 伯爵先生 (Mr. J. J. Comtesse) 获悉此事，该驳船当时正载着乘客和货物进行常规的江河贸易，在经过胶州浜 (Kiaochiao Creek) 时被拦停。

据悉，一艘日本拖轮呼叫过往驳船，当悬挂德国国旗的船只未能立即停船时，船上的武装人员向该船射击。无人被子弹击伤，但日本人随后据称将康特塞先生 (Mr. Comtesse) 带上他们的拖轮，并将其带到外滩的市政府轮渡浮码头。据报道，租界警察在此不被允许与他接触，据称他在众多路人目睹下遭到日本人殴打，并被拔出的佩刀威胁。后来他被带回胶州浜外的“江南”号 (Kiangnan) 并在那里获释。据悉，康特塞先生就是几周前在瑞士领事法庭审理的 Gulfarmod 诈骗案中涉案的人员。

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 8244
Date 17 12 37

Misc.1002/37.
"A"
Central
11th December 37.

1.

1.25 p.m. - 5p.m. City Government Pontoon
11-12-37. Detective Office.

- FOREIGNER IN CUSTODY OF JAPANESE
MILITARY.

At about 1.25 p.m. on the 11-12-37 Inspector
Brownrigg was informed by the J.P.C. on duty, Central
Station, that a foreigner was being detained at the
City Government Ferry Pontoon by the Japanese Military
Authorities.

On Inspector Brownrigg attending the aforementioned
pontoon he heard a cry from the North end, and then
observed a foreigner who had been locked behind an iron
grille door of the pontoon, being struck and pushed
about by a Japanese soldier, this soldier pulled out
his sword threatening the foreigner who was then dragged
inside out of sight.

Inspector Brownrigg explained to Major Yamamoto
through the medium of J.P.C.146 what had occurred, and
accompanied by the Major and J.P.C. proceeded to the
gate of the pontoon where they were admitted.

Inspector Brownrigg and the J.P.C. were told to
wait whilst the Major went inside to make enquiries. A
short time later the major returned and informed Inspt.
Brownrigg that the foreigner in question was a German
employed by the Japanese Military, and as he had been
having an altercation with some other persons, he was
being questioned by the Japanese Military regarding his
conduct.

日期：1937年12月17日

杂项 1002/37。
“A”区
中央巡捕房
1937年12月11日。

1.

下午1时25分至5时 市政府浮码头
1937年12月11日。侦探办公室。

- 外国人被日本军方拘留。

1937年12月11日下午约1时25分，布朗里格（Brownrigg）巡官接到中央巡捕房值班华捕警长（J.P.C.）报告，称有一名外国人正被日本军方当局拘留于市政府轮渡浮码头。

布朗里格巡官前往上述浮码头时，听到北端传来喊叫声，随后看见一名外国人被锁在浮码头的铁栅门后，遭到一名日本士兵殴打和推搡；该士兵拔出军刀威胁该外国人，随即将其拖入室内，直至看不见为止。

布朗里格巡官通过第146号华捕警长（J.P.C.146）向山本（Yamamoto）少佐说明了事发经过，并在该少佐及华捕警长的陪同下前往浮码头大门，获准进入。

布朗里格巡官和华捕警长被告知在原地等候，由少佐进入内部进行查询。片刻后，少佐返回并告知布朗里格巡官，涉事外国人为受雇于日本军方的德国人，因与其他人员发生争执，日本军方正就其行为对其进行讯问。

（左侧手写批注：）
抄送特别科主管警官

（印章：）
RB

Misc.1002/37(C)

1 (Sheet 2)

On inspector Brownrigg asking the major where the
foreigner had been moved to, the major replied that he
had been taken away by the Military Authorities.
Inspector Brownrigg then returned to the station and
informed Mr. Robertson, D.O. "A", and Detective Inspt.
Telfer.

Enquiries by the undersigned and D.S. Kobayashi
ascertained the following from Sergeant Major Kohashi,
City Government Ferry Pontoon.

At 1.30 p.m. on the 11-12-37, a foreigner was
brought to the aforementioned pontoon by a Japanese
Military officer for enquiries, which, as far as he
could understand, was for failing to stop when called
upon to do so, by a Japanese Military patrol on the
Whangpoo River. Several shots were fired at the launch
by the Japanese soldiers from their tug, and the
foreigner's launch eventually stopped. The foreigner's
launch was left at Jukong Wharf, and he himself was
brought in for enquiries. However, as no one could
interpret for the foreigner, he was taken by the
Japanese to Kiaochow and placed on board his launch.
No particulars re any Japanese soldiers having assaulted
the foreigner could be ascertained.

At 5 p.m. the foreigner named Comteese Jean Jacques
Swiss nationality, office situated at No.666 Szechuen

杂项 1002/37(C)

1（第2页）

当布朗里格巡官询问少佐该外国人被移至何处时，少佐回答称其已被军方当局带走。布朗里格巡官随即返回巡捕房，通知了“A”区侦探长罗伯逊（Robertson）先生及侦探巡官特尔弗（Telfer）。

经下文签署人及小林（Kobayashi）侦探警长查询，从市政府轮渡浮码头的曹长小桥（Kohashi）处获悉以下情况：

1937年12月11日下午1时30分，一名日本军官将一名外国人带至上述浮码头进行讯问。据其理解，原因是该外国人在黄浦江上被日本军方巡逻队喝令停船时未予配合。日本士兵从其拖船上向该外国人的汽艇开了数枪，该外国人的汽艇最终停下。该外国人的汽艇被留在菊宫码头（Jukong Wharf），他本人则被带来接受讯问。然而，由于无人能为该外国人翻译，日本人将其带至胶州（Kiaochow）[注：此处原文为Kiaochow，通常指青岛/胶州湾，但在上海语境下可能指代某特定地点或船只名，依指令保留原文含义或音译，此处结合上下文“placed on board his launch”推测可能为地名或误植，但按指令不脑补，直译或保留]，并让其登上自己的汽艇。未能查得有关日本士兵殴打该外国人的任何具体细节。

下午5时，该名外国人名为孔泰斯·让·雅克（Comteese Jean Jacques），瑞士国籍，办公地址位于四川路666号
